profile_md: Carnegie Mellon has no single university-wide sponsored-project scheme found in this reduced-depth review; sponsored team projects are run by colleges and departments. The best-evidenced route is Heinz College's semester capstone/Systems Synthesis (teams of 4-6 master's students plus a faculty advisor working free for external government, nonprofit and corporate sponsors; clients listed include Uber, Disney, PwC, Deloitte; 2026-27 handbook addendum corroborates currency). The Master of Software Engineering studio/practicum (teams of 4-6, company technical contact 1-3 hours a week, final presentations to sponsors) is strongly evidenced for design but undated. Further routes: Tepper MBA Strategic Management of the Enterprise (client companies; group basis unconfirmed), Statistics & Data Science corporate capstone (teams of 2-4, fall/spring), the MS-DAS industry capstone (2022 only), and the Entertainment Engineering course with TAIT (2026 news, cross-disciplinary teams). The legacy IDeATe row is all-major but shows no external client. All recorded routes are at programme or school level; most are postgraduate taught. Several pages are undated, and PDFs could not be text-extracted.
gaps: Undated sponsor pages (MSE, Tepper, Statistics); Heinz handbook PDF not text-extractable (course numbers from search summary); further instances likely: Tepper Global Capstones, INI practicum, MHCI/MSLE/MRSD capstones, ECE/MechE/MSE(materials) capstones, Design sponsored projects, Architecture studios, undergraduate Tepper/SCS practicum. Participation numbers not published in sources found. Search count approx 8 searches + 13 fetches.
